cells.title: Link decision search results to the concepts that cite them
cells.action: RED FIRST in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/decisions/tests.rs, beside the existing search tests. Build a temp repo with a decisions store and docs/knowledge/areas/x/a.md and b.md. Tests named with concept_link: (a) a decision whose short id appears in a.md gets concepts ["docs/knowledge/areas/x/a.md:<line>"] in --json and a text line '  knowledge: docs/knowledge/areas/x/a.md:<line>' after why/alternatives; (b) a decision with feature field 'feat-x' and text 'feat-x D2: ...' links to a line 'feat-x D1-D3' and not to a line 'feat-x D4'; (c) a decision with no link has no concepts key and its text has no knowledge line; (d) decisions active output never carries concepts. Run them and record the red output. FIX: add concept_links.rs in the decisions module: one function reads every *.md under <root>/docs/knowledge/ once (missing dir gives empty), and one function returns up to three 'path:line' strings for an event per D1 (short id = first 8 chars of id; feature from the feature field else the '<slug> D<n>' text prefix; D tokens on a line parsed after the slug: single Dn, lists separated by '/' or ', ', ranges 'Da-Db' or 'Da-b'; with a known n, require a token equal to n or a range covering it; without n, any D token; first matching line per concept; id hits first, then path order). In run_active_or_search, only when is_search, insert the concepts array into each linked result before emit, and append the knowledge line to that result's text. Keep decisions active untouched. Update the decisions search description in generated/registry_payload.json with one sentence naming the concepts key and the knowledge line (keep the file's JSON form; if a registry test pins the text, update it in the same commit). Add to docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/overview.md R5 one sentence: search results name the concept lines that cite them (decision-concept-links D1, D2). Write docs/history/decision-concept-links/delivery.md. No code comments. One commit.

truths: a search result whose short id or feature D-number is cited in a concept carries concepts and a knowledge line
a search result with no link keeps today's JSON and text bytes
a repo without docs/knowledge searches without error

artifacts.substantive: the concept scan and the link rule
concepts key and knowledge line on the search path only

key_links: the link rule follows decision-concept-links D1
the output shape follows contract decision-concept-links
open_choices: How the D-token parser is written

cells.title: Test the decision-concept-links contract edges
cells.action: Separate tester for dcl-1: do not change product code. Add tests named with concept_link in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/decisions/tests.rs for: the list forms 'feat-x D1/D5' and 'feat-x D1, D2' (D5 and D2 link, D3 does not); a range 'feat-x D1-D3' covers D3 and not D4; a slug that is only a prefix of another word does not link ('feat-x' vs 'feat-xy D2'); a decision with no D-number links to any 'feat-x D<n>' line; four citing concepts give exactly three, id hits first; a root with no docs/knowledge returns results with no concepts key and exit 0. If a test exposes a defect, return BLOCKED with the failing output; never fix product code. Run the verify, then a live run: .bee/bin/bee is not rebuilt, so run the built binary from the cargo target dir with 'decisions search --text "trust-layers D1" --json' at the repo root and record whether a concepts entry names docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/host-project-artifacts.md. Write docs/history/decision-concept-links/reports/dcl-2.md with each test name, the verify output count and the live run output. One commit.

truths: list, range, prefix, no-D-number, cap and missing-dir cases each have a passing concept_link test
the report quotes the verify pass count and the live run output

stages.reason: dcl-1 writes the concept scan, the output change and its first tests.
dcl-2 is the separate tester: edge-case tests of the contract and a live run.
dcl-1 updates the concept and the help text with the code.
dcl-1 owns the concept edit and delivery.md.
No release unless the owner asks.
Every job has a specific role.
Plan check runs inline at this size.
